assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md contains '## Workflow Mode Decision' with 'Mode: feature-branch' and rationale citing three atomicity constraints: 'Migration atomicity', 'Code-migration coupling', and 'Zero downtime requirement'. Concludes: 'These constraints require all changes to land together, which is the defining characteristic of feature-branch mode.'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' and is Task 1 (the first task in the plan). Impact map confirms: 'Task 1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | main | None | Bookend (create-branch)'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-7-merge-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch' and is Task 7 (the last of 7 tasks). Impact map confirms: 'Task 7 | Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main | main | Task 2, Task 3, Task 4, Task 5 | Bookend (merge-branch)'

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All intermediate tasks (2-6) have '## Target Branch\nTC-9005': task-2-database-migration.md line 5, task-3-entity-update.md line 5, task-4-advisory-service-endpoints.md line 5, task-5-ingestion-pipeline.md line 5, task-6-documentation.md line 5.

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main

All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1 as a dependency: task-2 '## Dependencies\n- Depends on: Task 1'; task-3 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main'; task-4 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main'; task-5 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main'. Documentation task 6 lists implementation tasks instead (Tasks 2-5), which is permitted by the assertion.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-7-merge-branch.md Dependencies section lists all four non-documentation intermediate tasks: 'Task 2 — Create database migration', 'Task 3 — Update SeaORM entity definitions', 'Task 4 — Update advisory service, model, and endpoints', 'Task 5 — Update advisory ingestion pipeline'. Task 6 (documentation) is correctly excluded.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Bookend tasks (non-documentation) are missing required sections. task-1-create-branch.md lacks Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes. task-7-merge-branch.md also lacks Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes. The assertion only exempts documentation tasks — bookend tasks are not exempted. Implementation tasks 2-5 have all required sections. Documentation task 6 correctly has Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements (and correctly omits Files to Modify/Create and Implementation Notes).

assertion_results.text: The plan includes a workflow:feature-branch label decision to be applied to the feature issue
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 19: '**Label decision:** Apply `workflow:feature-branch` label to TC-9005.' Also in summary-comment.md line 4: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to TC-9005.'

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: All 7 tasks have separate digest files with valid sha256-md: hashes (64 hex chars each): task-1-digest.md (sha256-md:d42a8482926a1767d2fe2b4262daddd36d5a4ae9549becdf78734ca1422de11d), task-2-digest.md (sha256-md:82992a48304feaf9e70f2e186812c7c4826b0e29b9be36590498d746951486ab), task-3-digest.md (sha256-md:2fc3f28ce960e8281ffddd9610aa9e64dc3891e56acd038787d0b85702f16ec2), task-4-digest.md (sha256-md:b0f58f53b5f27e6831c70dddfbc5a6f6b41fe8731cd38ba458ee87f6e37b2262), task-5-digest.md (sha256-md:8a1b99772db0e188aef6cad8035796c6fc6e8e01ffe52b4d083e87afb82476a9), task-6-digest.md (sha256-md:a93d400410eb8d907aacd9dabc3c0ed9b7ffb9760225510748e680aaf7c5a03d), task-7-digest.md (sha256-md:deb901930e9a605ba40da1377e31db5cdcd5d2c6bed255e39a047801087246c6).

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention annotations use the prescribed 'Applies:' format. Task 2: 'Applies: task modifies `migration/src/m0002_advisory_status_enum/mod.rs` matching the convention's `.rs` file scope.' Task 3: 'Applies: task modifies `entity/src/advisory.rs` matching the convention's `.rs` file scope.' Task 4 has three annotations all using 'Applies:' format with specific file paths and scope references. Task 5: 'Applies: task modifies `modules/ingestor/src/graph/advisory/mod.rs` matching the convention's `.rs` file scope.' No 'Not applicable' annotations found in any task file. Bookend and documentation tasks correctly omit convention annotations (no files matching convention scopes).

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md '## Inherited Field Propagation' section: '**Priority:** High (propagated from TC-9005 to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md confirms: '**Priority:** High (propagated from TC-9005 to all 7 created tasks)'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: CLAUDE.md has no '### Jira Field Defaults' section, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. impact-map.md documents: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from TC-9005 to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md confirms: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from TC-9005 to all 7 created tasks)'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in outputs directory with '### Inherited Fields' section listing: '**Priority:** High (propagated from TC-9005 to all 7 created tasks)' and '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from TC-9005 to all 7 created tasks)'. Additionally, impact-map.md has its own '## Inherited Field Propagation' section with the same information.
